rows.en: Lay down your arms at once and surrender to the Mu!
That was a fun diversion, but... this is the end!
Behold, Lady Maya!
Don't worry! You won't even have time to feel pain...!
Receive the retribution of time!
uncertain: Literal 'retribution of time' kept (MU time-themed phrasing).

rows.en: This is a warning! Give up and surrender!
So you've appeared, Xephon...!
This is the end, Ollin...!
Think you're a hero drawing a bow on the devil? It's the other way around!
Looks like a purge is in order!
Interesting...! Truly interesting, all of you!!
Why don't you at least beg for your life?
Do I have to hurt you before you understand?
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
N-Nobody told me about thiiis!!
What's going on...!?
No... Just who are you?
What is this...!!
There's no way we could lose... to red-blooded humans...!
What is this!? Against trash like this!?
I'm being pushed back!? Impossible!
My Largo, like this!? Im-impossible!!
Heh, don't push yourselves! Not bad, for the likes of you.
You fools who defy the Mu...!
Kufufufu... Would you make an enemy of God?
Now, that won't do...
You still have the strength to resist...
I don't recall giving you that option.
So you mean to defy me? That's fine too...!
Useless, useless! It's useless, you know?
Heh, what a boring diversion.
You really are utter fools!
Oh? Did something hit me?
Effort is powerless before destiny, you see.
Hmph! How pointless.
You just don't know when to give up, do you?
Clinging to a thread of hope... How foolish.
Go ahead, do as you like until you're satisfied.
A futile struggle.
Did I get a little carried away...?
You escaped nicely, but... it's only a matter of time now.
Fuhahahahaha! The time of judgment has come!
Whatever it is, it still counts as fighting strength.
uncertain: Kuki line with loose meaning; likely reacting to an ally or support; rendered impersonally.

rows.en: You will follow my orders here!
Kufufufu... What a delightful idea!
Too bad, but time's up...!
Now, look up at the sky! The Mu will show you the way!
This time I'll send you all to the prison of time that lasts forever!
Here I go!
Like I'd let you!
Now! Get ready!
I'm not as good as Elvy, but I can do it too!
That's far enough! Go down!
You're going to let me through!
I've gotta be able to handle a fighter jet, at least~
Nothing's impossible for me! Come on!
The Mu... our enemy...!
D-1 sighted, engaging!
uncertain: D-1 kept literally; unsure what Haruka's D-1 designation refers to.

rows.en: Fine, I'll play along with your game!
Would you mind not treating me like an amateur?
I'll never give up!
Ahh! Is this the end for me!?
I'm never giving up, you hear me!
Ahh! No way!!
Things are getting dicey... I have to do something...!
I-I was ready for this much!
They clearly outgun us... What do I do...?
I took that head-on!?
Aaah!!
Ahaha... Do you think insurance will cover this...?
Ugh, to a Dolem of all things...!!
You're not cute at all~...
Well, that's a surprise...
Uh-oh... I messed up~...
J-Just my imagination, just my imagination... Ahahahaha
Just what I'd expect from a Mu war machine...! But!!
You won't hit me!
That's it, let your guard down some more!
Come on, come on, try harder!
It's no use even trying, you know?
Rejected!
That kind of thing doesn't work on me!
Bye-byeee~!
Missiles: rejected!
See ya~!
Hmhmm~, you thought that'd hit, didn't you~?
Tch! Am I out of ammo!?
Damn, I lost the target...!
Hey! What is this!?
Call it a judgment call in the field!
Are you okay!? Ayato!
Out of the way, Elvy!
Ugh! Please make it in time...!
Ayato! No!!
Well now~, what should I have you treat me to?
I need support here!
I won't let you get away!
I'll land this hit, just watch!
All that's left is to put it into practice!
There!
Leave that enemy to me!
I'll show you results!
I'm taking the first move!
Now, can you make a move I didn't predict!?
Is th-that... Ms. Middi's vengeful obsession...!?
rows.notes: Aqua's sensei for Eldy rendered 'Ms. Middi', matching shipped dialogue.

rows.en: There's nothing else I can do now...!!
Eldy...! At least, at least let it be by my hand!!
Eldy! Please, stop it!!
It's no use! At this point, we have to take it down!!
uncertain: Hugo's line; the target is unnamed in source; rendered 'it' assuming the Medius Locus.

rows.en: If you... absolutely refuse to let AI1 go...!
Please, Ms. Middi! Stop this, please!!
Ms. Middi! You're possessed by AI1!!
Stay out of my way! My business is with Ms. Middi!
I won't lose to some Medius lackey!
Ugh! What an annoying bug!!
Now, it's our turn!
That last one showed me your movement pattern!
Don't think you can get away!
Give it up already!
I fell behind, but... I'll still show results!
Damn! Is this as far as I go!?
Oh no! Is the frame damaged!?
...The generator barely escaped a direct hit...!
I-I have to read the enemy's moves...!!
Kyaaah! A-at this rate...!!
Don't flinch! We're attacking!!
A-are you okay!? Are you hurt!?
What about you? Are you all right!?
D-do we have to prepare for the worst...!?
Not yet! Don't you ever give up!
Ugh! Checking all damage... We're still okay!
Hey! Isn't that rude to a lady!?
If you think I'll just back down, you're dead wrong!
Ugh! Did I take that one head-on!?
Right, I'll pay you back double for that!!
Ahh! A direct hit!?
As long as the unit moves, I'll manage! No, I'll make it work!
Sorry, that was careless of me...!
Never mind. Think about the next move.
Kuuh! I have to put my feelings aside, or I'm the one who goes down!!
That movement...!? Is Ms. Middi reading my thoughts!?
I have no choice... but to fight Ms. Middi...!
No! My read was wrong!?
Looks like my calculations were too optimistic...!
I guess I still have a long way to go...
That was all part of the plan... Let's just say that.
Oh, huh? It actually hit!?
Are you okay!?
Y-yeah... There's no need to worry.
S-sorry! It grazed us!
Don't worry about me. Focus on the fight.
Ugh! Where did we get hit!?
The chest front armor... But it won't affect combat!
Ugh! You actually managed to hit us!
Really, you'll be sorry later, you know?
Is the unit's response a bit slow...!?
I'll give the enemy credit there. But next time, I'll read it!
You're so obvious!
I knew you'd come at me that way!
Your moves are so predictable!
Don't think it's that easy to outwit me!
...Whoa, that was close!
It's fine, it's fine! Just watch me!
T-to free Ms. Middi from AI1...!
An attack, just as I predicted!
Something like that won't hit me!
It's not like I have precognition, you know?
You just picked the wrong target!
That was a little close, but... all's well that ends well!
I may not look it, but I'm surprisingly light on my feet!
uncertain: Unclear whether Aqua means herself or her unit; first person covers both.

rows.en: Thought that hit? Too bad!
Looks like I'm not needed here...
Nicely done.
Right? I'm great in real combat too!
Don't let your guard down, here comes the next one!
OK! Leave it to me!!
I-is it... no use anymore, Eldy...!?
I was... nothing at all to Ms. Middi...!
Ms. Middi! Please get out of the Medius Locus!
Rouga! Protect me!
Please! Rouga!!
S-so the shock still gets through...!
It beats taking a direct hit.
Useless!
You underestimated our defenses!
TE Sphere!!
Like I'd take an attack like that!
Well, our guard is solid...
TE Sphere, deploy!
...Didn't it deploy a little late just now?
Wh-what are you talking about! Come on, hurry and counterattack!
Better safe than sorry!
Just as I read it, you fired missiles!
How's that? Surprised!?
That's another way to do it!
Damn, we can't counterattack!
Calm down! I'll think of something!
How could I... misjudge the relative distance!
Ugh, it's fast...! Where did it go!?
Sorry, I lost it!
I'll catch it right away!
I can still go...! I'll cover you!
You failed to get away...! Sorry, but this is it!
Just as I read! I can still attack!
Support ready!
All right, one more hit!
We can attack from here too!
Right, this will finish it!
Look out!!
My unit can take the hit!
Don't think it'll go that well!
An ally's being targeted!
I won't let you!
Now, cut in!!
Right! I'll protect them!!
Everyone, please support me!
I'll finish it here!
Requesting support, please!
Now's our chance!
Let's finish them in one go!
Understood!
Got it! Here I go!
Bloody Ray!!
Bloody Ray, fire!!
Bloody! Raaay!!
Fang Knuckle!!
Take this! Fang Knuckle!!
Fang Knuckle! Goooo!!
Let's give it everything we've got!
Faaaang Knuckooo!!
Take this!
TEB limiter, release!
uncertain: 'TEB limiter' kept as abbreviation; TEB not in glossary.

rows.en: Ignition!!
Target lock! Go, Rouga!
I'm counting on you, Hiou!!
Target lock! Go, Hiou!
I'm counting on you, Rouga!!
Limiter released! Go!!
Trinity Dead End!!
Trinity!
Dead End!!
Now, prepare yourself!!
Take this!
Take that!
There you are!
Too slow! You're mine!
Become a sacrifice... for this Medius!
Your fear gives the Medius power!
If you die, you won't suffer. Yes... if you die here!
I'll teach you all what real battle is!
Time for you to disappear!
There's nothing to do but destroy you!
Your death will be etched into this Medius's memory!
Become fuel... for the world to come!
I'll show you all... what lies at the end of battle!
The fear of death or the pain of life... Choose which you'll accept!
I'll end it... your fight, and your suffering with it!
Now, steel yourself! Steel yourself to accept your fate!
Output is stable.
Understood. I'm engaging!
Sending enemy movement prediction data.
Roger. Commencing attack!
I'll go with my own judgment here!
Understood. I'll leave it to you.
Beginning data collection. I'll leave the rest to you.
Yeah, leave it to me.
AI1 has displayed the enemy's WP data.
Hmph... I'll take it as a reference, nothing more.
AI1, target locked. The rest is...
rows.notes: Eldy's line (shared Albero/Eldy set). Trails off.

rows.en: I'm the one who carries it out. Don't let that thing interfere.
It would be wiser to leave this to AI1.
Fighting for efficiency won't beat them. I'll teach AI1 that!
Keep a tight rein on that thing... on AI1!
...Understood.
AI1 doesn't need any needless fluctuations. I do hope you'll...
rows.notes: Eldy's line (shared Albero/Eldy set). Deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: Be quiet. This is my fight...!
Now then... let's see how much you've grown.
Hugo... you can never surpass me!
You can never surpass me!
I'll settle accounts with the past!
If you'd died back then, you'd have been spared the suffering...!
Do you think you can stop me!?
Go join my son in death! Hugo Medio!
uncertain: Whose son is not explicit; rendered 'my son' (Albero's).

rows.en: You too, go join my men and my sons in death!!
uncertain: Addressee unknown; 'my men and my sons' assumes Albero's dead subordinates.

rows.en: Someone like you could never read my moves!
Share Hugo's fate!
Share his fate!
Sorry... I never felt anything for you.
Aqua... I never felt anything for you.
Do you really think you can read my mind?
Aqua... do you really think you can read my mind?
Aqua... you were a student worth teaching. But... that's all.
You were a student worth teaching... But that's all.
To me, AI1's growth is everything...
Let me teach you how wonderful AI1 is, too.
I hated it... having a woman like you clinging to me.
You have no place in our plans.
You're nothing but a substitute, after all.
Aqua... you're nothing but a substitute, after all.
Hmph, so you showed up after all...!
You can't beat the Medius with that unit!
It's just a defective unit... You're no match for me!
What can you do with such an unstable unit!
Don't think you can escape!
I'll pay you back!
I won't give you anywhere to run!
I won't let this chance slip away!
Eldy, we're switching to a counterattack!
Understood.
Albero, a counterattack is possible.
Roger. Don't forget to collect data!
The enemy seems to intend to intercept us.
Then so be it!
We can counterattack... What will you do?
Strike, of course!
That's enough...! I'm withdrawing!
Nuoooh!?
This result... will give the Medius even more power!
Yes...! Come at me with everything you've got!!
Exceeding the data... That's what it means to be human!
Not yet! I can't die yet! Not until I've ended everything!!
Kh! Uuugh!!
Can the Medius not take any more than this!?
Please follow my instructions!
Keep your mouth shut! I'm the one doing the fighting!
AI1 is issuing a Level A warning...!
Then I'll teach it how to survive on a battlefield!
Gh! I taught you a sloppy finish can get you killed!!
Uooh!? Is he going to surpass me!?
uncertain: 'He' assumes the referent is Hugo (row is Albero-only, no ??? variant).

rows.en: Th-this is... his true strength!?
You turned your suffering into strength! But the same goes for me!!
That girl...! She exceeded my predictions...!?
I told you! You can't beat the Medius with that unit!!
You've earned your survival this far, I'll give you that...!
Ugh! But this pain will become food for AI1!
Nngh! To land a direct hit on the Medius!
Interesting...! You seem to be outstripping AI1's predictions!
Are you all right, Albero...?
Heh, you only care about me as a control device, don't you?
AI1 couldn't fully read the enemy's moves...?
A battlefield can't be grasped by data alone. Don't forget that!
Impressive... You've lived up to what I saw in you!
Th-this power...! So you've cut away your regrets!
That woman...! Has she seen through our moves!?
Thank you... This will raise AI1's experience.
Aqua... what will you try next?
Good read, Aqua.
A good read, for that girl.
Gh! You made up for the performance gap with skill!
Hoh, so you're keeping up with the Medius.
Hmph... It might be good experience for AI1, but...
Gh! I let my guard down!
Nngh! You're good!
Damage is minor. No problems with AI1 either.
Roger.
I believe I gave an evasion instruction?
I was merely teaching AI1 what pain is.
It seems my read was off...!
My apologies. Recalculating.
What's wrong? Weren't you going to take this Medius back?
You don't seem to be making full use of my teachings...!
Hugo! Hesitation will get you killed!
Hmph, a sloppy finish, just like him!
Fufufu... So you put a little thought into it.
You put a little thought into it, Aqua.
As I thought, your output isn't stable.
You mean to take back the Medius with that defective unit?
Just an amateur after all.
It seems you haven't fixed your old habits.
Hugo... it seems you haven't fixed your old habits.
Have you forgotten? I'm the one who raised you.
You're no match for me!
Hmph... Same old habits.
There's no need to rely on AI1...
To come out on the battlefield with skills like that...
Know that every wasted shot is an attack turned on yourself.
You can't win... not against me, nor against AI1.
Evasion successful... just as predicted.
It's all thanks to AI1.
It seems you couldn't read my moves.
Impressive. We've obtained some good data.
Just a defective unit... It can't catch the Medius.
Not with such an inexperienced pilot...
That won't work!
Deploying TE Sphere.
That won't reach me!
That's another way to do it!
Laughable!
Tch, I lost it!
If all you want is to survive, so be it.
Hmph... AI1 isn't reliable either.
I can't counterattack...!
Efficiency alone won't win you a battle.
Make the most of every opening! Remember that!
I'm not one to let that opening slip by!
The enemy cannot withdraw.
Then I'll corner it!
Tch, it can't be helped!
That one is still of use to me...!
All-out attack! Get them!
All units, concentrate fire!
AI1, target selection complete. Output is nominal.
Here I go!!
I'm hoping we'll obtain some good data.
Leave it to me!
Your luck has run out...!!
Perish here!!
You can't escape anymore...!!
Go! Into the endless dark!
Output rising, 110... 120... Go ahead.
Ignition...!
AI1, target locked. Charge complete.
Shatter to pieces!!
Fall! Into the fires of hell!!
